fieldValues.title: Essays cannot be organised like files
fieldValues.statement: I work on several essays at once, and they are like files: I need a landing page that shows them well, folders I create, essays I can move between folders, and a bin I can clear. Today each document is opened on its own, with nowhere to see or arrange them together.
source_ref: Owner, 2026-10-16: the writer persona, in a clerked session
